about_pullquote: I started Mowing Pastures Green because too many gardens were being neglected or overpriced.
about_para_1: Mowing Pastures Green was founded over a decade ago with a simple belief: good garden care shouldn't be a luxury or a hassle. What began as one person with a lawnmower has grown into a trusted service across Nottingham, handling everything from regular lawn maintenance to complete garden transformations. We've built our reputation on showing up on time, doing the job right, and leaving properties looking cared for.
about_para_2: Our customers stay with us because we listen, we're transparent about what we'll do and what it costs, and we treat every garden—whether it's a tiny courtyard or a sprawling lawn—with the same care and attention. We're not interested in cutting corners or upselling unnecessary work. You'll find us reliable, straightforward, and genuinely interested in making your outdoor space somewhere you want to spend time.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Been using Mowing Pastures Green for two years now for weekly cuts. Always turns up on time, never misses a slot, and the grass always looks immaculate. Fair prices too. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Our garden had turned into a complete jungle during lockdown. We called Mark and within a week it was cleared, tidied, and looking like a proper garden again. Brilliant job, very reasonably priced, would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Caroline M.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. They cleared our overgrown hedges, cut the lawn, and cleaned the patio all in one afternoon. Professional, friendly, and I'll definitely book them in for regular maintenance. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James T.
